title: 第三章 误会所致第四章 大事化小
content_zh:
黢黑的矿洞内并非完全无光，习惯了外面的光亮再进来，乍一下无法适应而已，洞壁上每隔一段距离便有一盏简易油灯，光线昏暗，勉强能看路。
挑着担的，一高一矮的两人有意放慢了脚步，不时前后打量。
这暗地里鬼鬼祟祟的两人，正是申尤昆口中咬牙切齿未清空的那两位，从身高上就能区分出二人谁是谁。
与前面的矿工拉开了距离，确定后面也无人靠近后，大高个子的吴斤两依然心有余悸的样子，小声嘀咕着朝旁抱怨，“好险，差点被申尤昆认了出来，我就说这样搞很危险，不让来，你偏要来凑热闹。”
师春嘀咕着回，“这不没事嘛，已经从舌头口中再三确认了的，都是一群外地来的生面孔，除了申尤昆，应该都不认识我们，刚才之所以当面撞上了他纯属碰巧，不可能老是撞上。”
吴斤两瞪眼提醒，“我说春天，你别在这侥幸，咱们这样搞未免也太光明正大了吧，万一又撞上了呢？他又不瞎，不可能老是看走眼，他对我们俩怕是恨之入骨，就我这身高，太明显了，你敢在他眼前晃来晃去，我怕呀！再撞上的话，十有**会被他给认出来，到时候他一声喊，我们立马就得被围殴…”
师春不屑打断，“喊什么喊，认不出我们则罢，真要当面撞破了，你让他喊一声试试，就他一个废了修为的货色，掐来当人质很难吗？只要我发现不对，随手的事，有什么好怕的？放心大胆的干，别疑神疑鬼吓自己。”
“呃…”吴斤两哑口挠头，想想，好像确实是这么回事，姓申的若再当面撞上是挺好抓的。
然转念一想又觉得不对，忙道：“不是，真的没必要再冒险了，人家毕竟这么多人手。东西咱们已经看到了，就一堆埋了不知多少年的骨头，咱们摸也摸了，探也探了，也没发现那骨架子有什么特别的名堂，关键那堆骨架子太大了，就算值钱，靠我们两个也弄不走，再看下去也是白看，时间久了容易暴露，赶紧撤吧。”
以前他也不会这样苦口婆心的反复劝拦这位大当家的决定，可如今毕竟是不同往日，他们已经攒到了足够的“功德”，东九原上担负的责任也全部卸下了，就算想再见城里那位老板娘的女儿一面，也完全没必要再冒险了，静候见面，然后就直接以“功德”兑换自由，犯不着再自找麻烦。
而他们两个之所以会出现在这里，说起来也跟他们刚攒够的那笔“功德”有关。
简而言之就是抢到了一大笔物资，真正的好大一笔，连他们自己都感觉很意外，一伙人高兴的不行，而这位大当家当时则皱着眉头对他嘀咕了一句，说感觉有些不对劲。
护卫的力量跟物资的数量似乎有些不匹配，意思是得手的似乎过于轻松了。
他觉得没什么，只要东西到手了就行，可这位大当家却在抢劫的地点留了个心眼。
后来东西送到城里，成功出手后，这位大当家又觉得不对，又觉得出手得太顺利了。
说是能在流放之地筹备到这么多物资的人，实力和势力应该不弱，不想办法抢回去也就罢了，居然连找来理论的勇气都没有，换了是他们东九原被抢了这么多东西就算没能力抢回去，也会放出风声让被抢的大笔物资引来觊觎，给对手添点麻烦，可事情顺利的连一点异常风声都没听闻。
之后，抢劫地点预留的心眼也带回了消息，守了几天，没见任何人去抢劫现场勘察和追查。
而那大笔物资按照行价兑换的“功德”，恰好足以换来他们东九原所有人的自由，面对这个数目，这位大当家皱眉沉默了很久。
面对兴奋沸腾后再也按捺不住的大家，只怕任何理由都拦不住他们要离开的心，这位大当家没有多说什么，公平公正地把“功德”分给了大家。
一番喧嚣后清净了，就这样把大家给送走了，这位大当家目送着，忽拱手朝大家离去的背影献上了一个长长久久的鞠躬。

他发现这位大当家红了眼眶，当时似乎流泪了。
大当家扭过了头，好像不想让他看到，然后他也就装作没看到。
最后就他们两个没走，他以为他能理解大当家的为何不走，博望楼老板娘的女儿，差不多每三个月会来就近的城里盘一次账，大当家的喜欢人家算是人尽皆知的事。
三个月才能见一次，留下来等着见一面也能理解，毕竟就要离开了，就算要不到人家外面的联系方式，起码也要见面告个别吧，不然怕是自己都无法给自己一个交代。
谁知大当家的却跟他另做了布置，说他们留下兴许能做饵，说若真是有心人想送他们走，发现他们没走，必然要来查探。
他觉得大当家想多了，这鬼地方谁能有那好心给这么多物资送他们离开？
后来真的有人来了，然后这边逆向溯源，把幕后的申尤昆给摸了出来。
content_en:
The dark mine is not completely lightless. Once you get used to the light coming in from outside, you may not be able to adapt to it at first. There is a simple oil lamp at regular intervals on the cave wall. The light is dim and you can barely see the road.
The two people carrying the load, one tall and one short, deliberately slowed down their pace and looked back and forth from time to time.
These two people who were sneaking around in the dark were the two people that Shen Youkun was gnashing his teeth about. You could tell who was who between them based on their height.
After he had distanced himself from the miners in front and made sure that no one was approaching from behind, the tall Wu Jinliang still looked frightened. He muttered and complained to the side, "It was so dangerous. I almost got recognized by Shen Youkun. I said it was very dangerous and I was not allowed to come, but you decided to join in the fun."
Shi Chun muttered back, "Isn't it okay? I have confirmed it repeatedly from my tongue and mouth. They are all a group of strangers from out of town. Except for Shen Youkun, none of us should know us. The reason why we bumped into him in person just now was purely by chance. We can't always bump into him."
Wu Jinliang glared and reminded, "I said Spring, don't take any chances here. It would be too fair for us to do this. What if we bump into each other again? He's not blind, so he can't always see things wrong. I'm afraid he hates both of us. It's so obvious at my height. If you dare to dangle in front of his eyes, I'm afraid! If we bump into him again, he will most likely recognize us. When he shouts, we will be beaten immediately..."
Shi Chun didn't bother to interrupt, "What are you shouting for? If you don't recognize us, just forget about it. If we really want to confront him, let him shout. Is it difficult to hold him as a hostage for a guy who has lost his cultivation? As long as I find something is wrong, what is there to be afraid of? Just do it boldly and don't be suspicious and frighten yourself."
"Uh..." Wu Jinliang scratched his head dumbly. Thinking about it, it seems that this is indeed the case. It would be easy to catch the person named Shen if he bumped into him again.
But then I thought something was wrong and said hurriedly: "No, there is really no need to take risks anymore. After all, they have so many people. We have already seen the things. They are just a pile of bones that have been buried for countless years. We touched and explored, but we did not find anything special about the skeleton. The key point is that the pile of skeletons is too big. Even if it is valuable, the two of us can't remove it. It will be in vain to look at it. It will be exposed after a long time. Let's move out quickly."
In the past, he would not have tried so hard to persuade the big boss of his decision, but now it is different from the past. They have accumulated enough "merit" and all the responsibilities on Dongjiuyuan have been relieved. Even if they want to see the daughter of the landlady in the city, there is no need to take risks anymore. They can wait to meet and then directly exchange their "merit" for freedom, so there is no need to ask for trouble again.
And the reason why the two of them are here is related to the "merit" they just saved.
In short, they grabbed a large sum of supplies, a really huge sum, which even they themselves were surprised by. The group of people were extremely happy, but the big boss frowned and muttered to him, saying that something felt wrong.
There seems to be a mismatch between the strength of the guards and the amount of supplies, which means that the success seems to be too easy.
He thought it was nothing, as long as he got the things, but the boss kept a careful eye on the location of the robbery.
Later, when the items were delivered to the city and the operation was successful, the boss felt that something was wrong and that the operation went too smoothly.
It is said that the people who were able to prepare so many supplies in the Exiled Land should be strong and powerful. They just want to snatch them back. They don't even have the courage to find a theory. Instead, they Dongjiuyuan was robbed of so many things. Even if they were unable to snatch them back, they would spread the word to attract covetousness of the large amount of stolen supplies and cause some trouble to their opponents. However, things went smoothly without even hearing any unusual rumors.
OfLater, the detective at the robbery site also brought back the news. After several days of guarding, no one went to investigate and investigate the robbery site.
And the "merits" exchanged for the large amount of materials according to the market price were enough to buy the freedom of all of them in Dongjiuyuan. Faced with this amount, the big boss frowned and remained silent for a long time.
Facing everyone who could no longer hold back their excitement, fearing that no reason could stop them from leaving, the big boss didn't say anything more and distributed the "merits" to everyone fairly and fairly.
After a lot of commotion, everything was quiet, and everyone was sent away. The head of the family watched them off, and suddenly raised his hands and bowed for a long time towards everyone's leaving figures.
He found that the big boss's eyes were red and he seemed to be crying.
The boss turned his head as if he didn't want him to see it, and then he pretended not to see it.
In the end, they were the only two who didn't leave. He thought he could understand why the big boss didn't leave. The daughter of the proprietress of Bowang Tower would come to the nearest city almost every three months to do an accounting. It was common knowledge that the big boss liked her.
They can only meet once every three months, so it's understandable to stay and wait for a meeting. After all, they are leaving. Even if they don't have contact information outside the family, they should at least meet and say goodbye, otherwise I'm afraid I won't be able to give myself an explanation.
Unexpectedly, the boss made other arrangements with him, saying that if they stayed, they might be used as bait. He said that if someone really wanted to send them away and found that they hadn't left, they would definitely come and investigate.
He felt that the boss was thinking too much. Who in this damn place could be kind enough to give them so many supplies to send them away?
Later, someone really came, and then they traced the source backwards and found out Shen Youkun behind the scenes.
